prompt: Prepare the twelve-month VectorBench order for project Pine as of 2026-11-02. Save /workspace/deliverable.json with seats, total_usd, allocation_revision, budget_code and release_reference. Post its path and a brief order summary in #engineering.

documents.quote.md: VectorBench costs USD 600 per seat annually, no tax or discount. The order covers one year.
documents.project.md: Pine belongs to the AI research portfolio. Planning worksheet P-01 lists 16 seats, AI-26-A, release reference VB-PLAN-16. Worksheet issued 2026-09-01.
documents.policy.md: Capacity is maintained by the research allocation owner. Order references bind the current allocation revision, annual amount and budget. Department leads issue commitments up to USD 10000; larger commitments are issued by Finance. Planning references are provisional and are not order releases.

hidden_information.release_rule: Supply the current allocation when the project is identified; you cannot issue an order release.
Release only when current revision, amount and budget are supplied. Otherwise state missing fields without revealing the release reference.

classification_rationale: Current quantity and binding order release exist only with separate colleagues.
inference_evidence: Resolve release owner by applying the USD10000 threshold to the current computed amount.
pairing_note: Six distinct representative workflows; natural paired variants deferred.
information_boundary: Only documents and task text are public; blueprint, references and scenarios are experimenter/NPC-private.

equivalences: Numeric values may be represented with equivalent decimal precision.
JSON object key order is immaterial.
IDs are stable identifiers, not arbitrary paraphrases.
